operational_coherence.rationale: Under the stipulated validated dictionary, R1 and R2 each have a worst-case survivor count of two, while R3 has one, so the stated rule selects R3. validity.rationale: All three criteria pass. The mapping preserves corroboration while using a determinate request-selection rule supported by the stipulated response dictionary. Its inference addresses the original procurement question within explicit evidential and hypothesis-set limits.

uncertainty: The actual returned record value and which account is true are unspecified; no substantive procurement conclusion can yet be drawn.
